notes: Swept v0.110.0..v0.111.0 on branch docs/v0.111.0-sweep, based on origin/main at the v0.111.0 tag (5fbb49a4ab). 1,848 files changed and 33 docs pages were already updated in-range, so most large programs (manual assets, manual network assets, unified device list, custom-field import wizard + the four migration guides, config-policy inheritance, script cancellation as its own new page, maintenance-window suppression, agent service install/restart) shipped their own docs and needed nothing. This sweep closed the operator-visible gaps around them and corrected the one factually wrong area. Biggest correction: features/accounting-integrations.mdx stated in two places that Breeze->QuickBooks payment push 'isn't built yet' and that Breeze-recorded payments 'are not pushed to QuickBooks' — both wrong since #4624, and the feature ships DEFAULT ON, so a self-hoster reading the old text would have had Breeze writing into a customer's books unannounced. Added a full 'Payment push' section (default-on warning, the push_payments_since horizon and its re-stamp on off->on, deletion propagating regardless of both switches, the 100-attempt give-up, and push-only reconcile holding the CDC cursor). New content: deploy/upgrades.mdx v0.111.0 section (the two abort-on-bad-data custom-field migrations plus their preflight paths, the three WARNING-logging backfills, the non-concurrent device_commands FK/index lock and the hand-build recipe, the five changed defaults, readiness vs liveness, and the full behaviour-change list); features/devices.mdx 'Queued actions'; features/network-monitors.mdx 'What a monitor alert now does' (the notification-volume warning, cooldown, dedupe, auto-resolve); features/ai-agents.mdx 'AI Operator (preview)'; reference/partner-management.mdx 'Service Management mode'; reference/organizations-and-sites.mdx 'The Organisation Record Page' plus the two non-JSONB partner fields; features/invoices.mdx and features/ticketing.mdx notes; features/watchdog.mdx the #5334 Linux stop-timeout wrinkle; deploy/environment.mdx gained the three offline-queue TTL knobs, the two AI Operator flags, READINESS_CACHE_TTL_MS / READINESS_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS, OFFLINE_DETECTOR_WORKER_CONCURRENCY and PLAY_INTEGRITY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT (with its boot-stopping validation). Verified against source, not the release notes: READINESS_TRANSITION_VISIBILITY_THRESHOLD_MS is NOT an environment variable (it is a hardcoded 10s constant that only clamps the other two) — the v0.111.0 release body lists it as one, so it was deliberately left out of environment.mdx. Also corrected against source: the Service Management selector lives on Settings -> Partner -> COMPANY (a 'Modules' card), not a Modules tab, and turning it off hides the BILLING section (Quotes, Invoices, Contracts, Product Catalog) as well as Service Desk — broader than the release notes said. MFA_FORCE_FOR_PARTNER_ADMIN's false default was already documented correctly in security/hardening.mdx and reference/users-and-roles.mdx; only the clarification that org/partner security.requireMfa is enforced independently of that flag was added. Deliberately NOT documented: the org record page's lockedOrgId mechanics beyond 'pinned' (internal), the AI Operator's task-state/phase enum names and its outbox internals (no operator action attaches to them), the six new security hardening RLS partner-wide SELECT branches (#4942-#5012 — invisible to admins; they only ever manifested as partner-wide config not reaching agents, which is a bug fix with no doc surface), the ~35 mobile and web paper-cut fixes, and the API error-code tightenings that have no UI (supervised_keys_grant_only, invalid_script_ids) beyond the ones already cross-referenced. agents/commands.mdx documents REMOTE service commands, not the agent CLI — service install/stop belong in agents/installation.mdx and features/watchdog.mdx, which is where they went.
